name: landing on Algora
how_you_get_it: Fly through the flickering wormhole to Galaxy Patternox. How the game opens it is the main thread's wiring.
source: [Proposal; built on the big world page, not in the game]

name: Elder Rivet
how_you_get_it: Talk to him in Mender Village.
used_for: The plates job, the pip pouch, the Rule Stone.
source: [Proposal; built on the big world page, not in the game]

name: New plates for the four machines
how_you_get_it: Test each machine with grey stones. Write its plate.
maths: Find the rule of a number machine (3.OA.9)
used_for: Lights the Menders' Rule Stone: 1 of 5. A card.
source: [Proposal; built on the big world page, not in the game]

name: pip pouch
how_you_get_it: Elder Rivet gives it after the first true plate.
used_for: The bridge pan.
source: [Proposal; built on the big world page, not in the game]

name: Exactly the right pips on the bridge pan
how_you_get_it: Run the pouch through machines with true plates. Say each result first.
used_for: Brings the bridge down: one way over the Rill. A card.
source: [Proposal; built on the big world page, not in the game]

name: Cross the old stepping stones
how_you_get_it: Look at the old post, north by the reeds.
maths: Go on with a number pattern (3.OA.9)
used_for: The second way over the Rill. A card.
source: [Proposal; built on the big world page, not in the game]

name: the Reach's landing
how_you_get_it: Over the bridge OR over the old stones (either one).
used_for: The Rillfolk guard; the lookout hill. The road east is not built.
source: [Proposal; built on the big world page, not in the game]

name: Pim, a Mender child
how_you_get_it: Talk to Pim in the village.
used_for: Asks for a lost red spinner.
source: [Proposal; built on the big world page, not in the game]

name: red spinner
how_you_get_it: In the grass by the pond.
used_for: Pim.
source: [Proposal; built on the big world page, not in the game]

name: Pim gets the spinner
how_you_get_it: Give the spinner to Pim.
used_for: A clue: the old stones, up north. A card.
source: [Proposal; built on the big world page, not in the game]

name: the orchard keeper
how_you_get_it: Talk to him twice.
used_for: Speaks of a lucky coin that rolled into something hollow.
source: [Proposal; built on the big world page, not in the game]

name: hollow log
how_you_get_it: South of the village, by the tall grass.
used_for: Holds a Maker's coin.
source: [Proposal; built on the big world page, not in the game]

name: Maker's coin
how_you_get_it: In the hollow log.
used_for: The orchard keeper.
source: [Proposal; built on the big world page, not in the game]

name: the keeper gets his coin

name: rubble by the old wall
how_you_get_it: Look at the rubble east of the Wall Machine.
used_for: Holds a thick black shard.
source: [Proposal; built on the big world page, not in the game]

name: thick black shard
how_you_get_it: In the rubble.
used_for: Show it to Elder Rivet.
source: [Proposal; built on the big world page, not in the game]

name: Elder Rivet knows the shard
how_you_get_it: Show the shard to Elder Rivet.
used_for: It is a piece of the Gate's own plate. A card. Later: it fits at the Gate or the Old Works.
source: [Proposal; built on the big world page, not in the game]

name: rope ladder
how_you_get_it: The Furrows' thanks.
used_for: Down the canyon cliff; up to ledges in places already seen.
source: [Proposal, later]

name: star lamp
how_you_get_it: The Eights' thanks.
used_for: Lights caves on Algora, and Chronosia's dark passage for every child.
source: [Proposal, later]

name: measure the terrace wall
how_you_get_it: Bring Lengthar's measuring tape to the Furrows.
used_for: An epic card.
source: [Proposal, later]

name: short cave in the Woods' ridge
how_you_get_it: A light from another planet (the glow stone), or Algora's own star lamp.
used_for: A short cut and a find.
source: [Proposal, later]

name: the square tree
how_you_get_it: Bring Xylophora's leaf print stone to the Pattern Woods.
used_for: The leaf fits. A find.
source: [Proposal, later]

name: the Clockmaker by the lake
how_you_get_it: Marc's decision. He came by the time portal, one way.
used_for: Explains gates. A letter to carry home: an epic card.
source: [Proposal, later; Marc's decision]

name: the harbour keeper
how_you_get_it: Talk to her in the harbour, past the reed gate.
used_for: The fleet job; the Rillfolk's Rule Stone; the raft.
source: [Proposal; built on the big world page, not in the game]

name: three order tags
how_you_get_it: One from each town's speaker: Stilt Town, Reed Town, Mud Town.
used_for: Hung on the loading board.
source: [Proposal; built on the big world page, not in the game]

name: Load the fleet for three towns
how_you_get_it: Hang the tags. For each town choose a kind of raft and how many.
used_for: Lights the Rillfolk's Rule Stone: 2 of 5. The ship's Navigation to Level 2. A card. A raft.
source: [Proposal; built on the big world page, not in the game]

name: raft
how_you_get_it: The harbour keeper's thanks.
used_for: Later: short cuts on the lake and the coast. Never one of a border's two ways.
source: [Proposal; built as a keepsake for now]

name: bottle with a note
how_you_get_it: In the reeds, south of the harbour.
used_for: Carry it to Pim, over the river.
source: [Proposal; built on the big world page, not in the game]

name: Pim gets the note
how_you_get_it: Give the bottle to Pim in the Menders' village.
used_for: A card. It links two regions.
source: [Proposal; built on the big world page, not in the game]

used_for: "Something glints. A rope with a hook could reach it." A mini quest of the lantern shape begins.

name: the net mender

name: bundles of long reeds

source: [Proposal; built on the big world page, not in the game]

name: rope with a hook
how_you_get_it: The net mender twists it from the reeds.

name: the Makers' box
